thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy failed for service=redwood-runtime, release=2026.03.14-rc3. Error: image manifest mismatch (multi-arch). Canary instances returning 502s in us-west-2.

incidents-bot: Paging maya (oncall) — escalation policy: oncall-primary -> oncall-secondary.

maya (oncall): seeing the alert. Confirming noisy 502 spikes on the canary group. Stopping the rollout now.

devon: +1. Which pipeline pushed that manifest? I see a matching tag `rc3` but the amd64 and arm64 manifests point to different digests.

sam: logs from the registry: `PUT /v2/redwood/runtime/manifests/rc3` by ci-worker-12 at 14:02:13 UTC. Afterwards another push by ci-worker-9 at 14:03:01 overwrote the index with a different manifest list. Looks like concurrent pushes.

maya (oncall): can someone flip the deploy kill-switch? feature flag `deploy.canary.autopause`?

lee: I toggled `featureflag:deploy_canary_autopause` to ON for the org via console. Confirmed: `featureflag:deploy_canary_autopause = true` :white_check_mark:

devon: good. I'll pin the canary replicas to the previous image digest to stop the bad manifest from being used. Running: `kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/redwood-runtime redwood-runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd1234efgh`

sam: hold on — the cluster autoscaler just restarted some canary pods, they pulled `rc3` which resolves to the bad manifest on the registry mirror. We should mark the `rc3` tag as deprecated at the registry level and add a redirect.

maya (oncall): who's owning the registry kill? I can add a deny rule on the mirror.

devon: I'm on it. Applying ACL to mirror-store: `registryctl block-tag --host mirror-usw2.redwood.internal --tag rc3 --reason "manifest mismatch"`

deploy-bot: Registry action recorded: block-tag accepted (ticket=REG-5831).

sam: quick analysis: CI job pipeline A (multi-arch build) and pipeline B (retag step) both wrote `rc3` within a 45s window. Pipeline B didn't wait for manifest consolidation and pushed a manifest list that referenced an unbuilt arm64 layer (digest mismatch). This caused kubelet on some nodes to pull an inconsistent set of layers -> 502 on runtime start.

maya (oncall): Customer impact: errors for a subset of sessions routed to canary nodes in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 mirror. We have ~1200 affected requests/minute during the spike. CS is already alerted.

sre-lead: please record affected customers and severity. This looks Sev2 for now since majority of traffic hit healthy replicas.

devon: mitigation summary so far: 1) paused rollout via kill-switch, 2) blocked `rc3` on mirror, 3) pinned canary to previous digest for immediate stability, 4) restarted any broken canary pods after pin. Error rate dropping to ~80r/min now.

maya (oncall): creating an incident ticket and assigning postmortem. `INC-2026-042` created and linked to runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/artifact-issue

sam: for short-term rollback to fully stable state I'd recommend rolling back canary to `2026.03.13` tag and re-running the multi-arch build with serialized push steps.

lee: noted. I'm also going to add a temporary registry webhook that rejects concurrent manifest writes with the same tag. Quick patch applied to staging mirror.

devon: to be safe, we should also invalidate CDN cache for runtime layers in case any node got a mixed set. `cdnctl purge --paths /images/redwood/runtime/*rc3*`

maya (oncall): done. Also pinged CS and account execs: short note sent to affected customers in eu/us about transient 502s during deploy.

incidents-bot: Reminder: if incident lasts >2h, escalate to oncall-manager.

maya (oncall): handoff note for next oncall in 30m: root cause suspected race in CI retag step; current state = stable (error rate down to ~20r/min), registry block in place, rollback scheduled if error rate doesn't drop below 5r/min. Owning: devon/sam for next 2h.

sre-lead: good play. We'll draft a postmortem and add CI guard rails: mutex for retag step and manifest verification (compare multi-arch list digests before and after push).

devon: open action items: [REG-5831] blocked tag, [CI-7240] serialize retag job, [DEP-1122] add manifest-consistency check in pipeline.

maya (oncall): closing this thread for now but will update incident ticket when DEP-1122 changes land. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident closed by maya (oncall). Metrics stabilized.
